title: 裁切结果审核
intent: 新裁切产生后独立审核，不把使用裁切当作审批。
brief: Stage5 裁切画布 ACTIVE 待审核. Title "检查裁切结果". One large final-cropped transparent fox preview, NO drag handles or crop-edit outline. Right noninteractive checks "主体没有被切掉" / "边缘留白合适". Footer ONE teal "通过裁切结果", outlined "调整裁切边界", quiet "驳回裁切结果". Note "通过后设置印刷尺寸，当前结果尚未保存。". Do not say PNG final or show save forms. This is customer route crop review, not crop edit.
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. One high-fidelity raster screen for PrintFlow Studio SCRUM-11168 expanded visual prototype. Reference image is an APPROVED design-system and synthetic-artwork reference, not an edit target. Preserve its calm off-white and white surfaces, forest teal #16765D, graphite text, thin dividers, sensible 10px corners, generous efficient spacing, crisp Simplified Chinese CJK sans serif. Same original geometric mark, exact "PrintFlow Studio" titlebar, small "视觉原型 v2", window controls. One complete front-on edge-to-edge Windows desktop UI screenshot, landscape 16:10, no device/browser/outer presentation board. Same fox illustration and foliage as reference, identical sample artwork and transparent checkerboard when background removed. Default task filename 山野狐狸.png and route 处理客户设计, unless brief overrides. Default left eight-stage user rail: 导入与路线 / 确认原图 / 图片增强 / 去除背景 / 裁切画布 / 印刷设置 / 生成与审核 / 保存结果. Only stages before CURRENT are completed; future steps muted and nonexecutable. Footer fixed with one recommended primary and qualified secondary actions. Main picture and current decision are focal. No irrelevant future forms, no real customer data, no invented operational facts. Use exact quoted Chinese labels in brief; concise text only, no illegible filler. Check prompts' constraints carefully, don't add hidden behavior, automatic approval, auto-resume, printing, cloud or account features. All statuses and measurements are fictional scenario states for prototype, not evidence of a live production file. Output ONLY this one complete practical screen.
SCENARIO: 
IMPORTANT: Reference controls and text must NOT be copied when not in the scenario. Never show a fabricated enhanced result before processing starts. Use spinner only for unknown progress, never ratio-filled progress bars. Do not carry colleague-correction hints onto enhancement/other reviews. No default selection for white-ink choice. Stage5 裁切画布 ACTIVE 待审核. Title "检查裁切结果". One large final-cropped transparent fox preview, NO drag handles or crop-edit outline. Right noninteractive checks "主体没有被切掉" / "边缘留白合适". Footer ONE teal "通过裁切结果", outlined "调整裁切边界", quiet "驳回裁切结果". Note "通过后设置印刷尺寸，当前结果尚未保存。". Do not say PNG final or show save forms. This is customer route crop review, not crop edit.
revisionPrompt: Edit only right inspection guide: replace both green checked circles with neutral gray bullet dots (noninteractive, not checked). Replace text 主体没有被切掉 with 主体有没有被切掉？ and 边缘留白合适 with 边缘留白是否合适？. These are prompts for human inspection, not automatically passed facts. Keep all else exactly.

title: 正在安全停止
intent: 停止请求尚未完成时不宣称已停止。
brief: Stage3enhancement amber stopping. Title "正在请求停止". Spinner only. Clear text "已发送停止请求，请等待当前操作结束。"; note "确认停止前，不会开始下一步。". Small source preview, disabled "正在停止…" button. No approve, retry, force close, take over, or stop-success claim. Neutral note "请勿强制关闭外部应用。".
